verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.airweave.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an "Instructions for AI Agents" section, which tells agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown. The cited docs are indeed served as `.md` pages. Agent-oriented material goes further: official skills teach agents in Cursor, Claude Code and Gemini CLI how to use Airweave, and an OpenAPI spec is published. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming the llms.txt or Markdown docs, and the full contents of llms.txt (the probe excerpt is truncated).
